clips.title: The story
paras: In eastern Loch Modan, troggs keep Prospector Ironband's excavation from advancing. His report asks for more blastpowder after earlier supplies were sent weeks ago.

Prospector Ironband's digging in Loch Modan is repeatedly disrupted by nearby troggs. His progress report, carried to Jern Hornhelm in Thelsamar and then sent on to the Explorers' League in Ironforge, describes the stalled work and asks for heavy munitions. League leaders already sent Ironband plenty of blastpowder weeks ago, and now wonder where those shipments went.
